a.text: I suddenly realize, ever since I came to Shangshu, I haven't had a proper sleep.
There's a great commotion outside. It seems two people are fighting.
But I know their fight isn't because of each other. They're fighting over me, and that cup.
I've always considered myself fine at reading people. I've guessed, too, that this can't all be that simple.
My premonitions have never been far off the mark either. So I've prepared two letters, sat on the table.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Let's not trouble our Mr. Liang for now.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But I am curious. Are you just allowed in or out of the Liang estate whenever? Liang Xun might not put on government airs, but this has to be a little too careless.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Stop there!

steps.name: Travel-Weary Woman
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) Crikey, my list didn't have nothin' about this sheila!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hmph. Nowhere to run.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Who sent you?!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Wait, you're not even Yanese! Where did you come from?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Here I was thinking you kicked the bucket in your sleep.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You're...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: (Are these beasts long-snouted slumberfoots?)

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: She was clearly scheming something outside your room. You think do-gooders do that?

steps.name: Travel-Weary Woman
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) I'm not secret here anymore, so it's in for a penny, in for a pound...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Er, okay, Rim Billitonian woman, hold your beasts...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: This is the Shangshu magistrate's land. I don't mind either way, but getting on the court man's bad side won't do you any favors.

steps.name: Travel-Weary Woman
steps.text: (Rim Billitonian) You're able to rabbit on in the ol' Rim Bil?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Roughly.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: May I have your name, young woman? And what are you paying your very bold visit here for?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Ye Ban. Blacknight.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Why were you ignoring me if you could speak Yanese?!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You're a Rim Billitonian, but you have a Yanese name?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: That's not the point. I really don't end up in these situations, but I'm not looking for too much trouble in this city anyway.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: A hunt with no traps and no plan is a hunt just waiting to fail.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Give it up. You're not pulling any schemes here with me on the scene.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Miss Du's a temperamental sort.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: So you two are working together.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: This works out just fine, actually. While you've been focusing on me...

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: Light, Drill!

steps.name: Nearby Howl
steps.text: Wrroooaw—!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: (There's more slumberfoots!)

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Gah! It's got the goblet in its mouth!

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: See you never!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hold it right there!!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hey! What dimension are you living in? After her!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Long-snouted slumberfoots don't live in Yan, let alone keeping a cadre of tame ones as your partners in crime. This woman's probably come chasing us from somewhere else entirely.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What are you still thinking about? If I didn't help you, she would've trapped you to death right there!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: No, I wouldn't say she was after my life.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Cool, you lost the goblet, and you don't even act like you care. Aren't you scared Mr. Liang's gonna chew you out?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Now I've lost the cup, and your hopes have come true. Isn't that just dandy?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Tch... Fine, I said that, but if this spirals out of our control, what do we do then?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I just wanted my dad to suck it for once. I didn't think the whole Association would be done for.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Where's Liang Xun?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor, this... matter you raise... it's far beyond the pale. You'll have to let me absorb this slowly.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Don't blame you. I've known Nian forever, but I still need some time to take this in.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: And you told me without the slightest reservation.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You're a Rhodes Island operator too.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Right you are, benefactor.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But... whether or not we agree with it, having a nation's top organizations watching Rhodes Island so closely... doesn't make for easy sleeping at night.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: The Sui Regulator, the Ministry of Rites. Just their names alone are intimidating.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Yet I didn't quite pick up on any malice when they spoke to us, you know?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Perhaps we've taken 'Nian's household affairs' too simply.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Eugh. Should at least have Amiya and the Doctor know about this before we make any calls...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But it's not like Closure and Amiya'd have no idea about this, right...? But they agreed to Nian's requests too, back then...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: And who knows if Lava's given the branch office a shout yet.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor, given things are currently brewing up a storm, perhaps we should put our own safeties first, don't you think, or...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: We'll discuss this with Mr. Lee first. Nian be damned, but Dusk's not somebody who makes things mysterious on purpose.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: If what she said was true, then it looks like this whole thing has a lot more moving parts than we thought...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: A safe proposition. That's my benefactor.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You say that when Yan's Sui Regulator's already come knocking. Don't think safe's the day of the word here—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor...? What has you furrowing your brow?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: This thing's—

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Ao!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: —! Nothing, move it!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: ...Oho!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Wh—What in the world...?!

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Fphhh...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What? Is this some... metal animal?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: W—Wait, that's a teapot, that's a painting frame... Are these things alive—?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Where did these things crawl out from—h-hold on, has that teapot grown legs?

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Wrroooaw—!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Wargh!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Watch out, benefactor!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: A fair, square hit!

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: (Wails)—!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Looks like that works—!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —Slow down, this—thing's turned back into a common paperweight...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: (Damn—they're all over the place here—!)

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Aaaaow!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —Benefactor!

steps.name: Curious Passerby
steps.text: What's happening? You're making lots of noise here... um, uh, why's that flowerpot moving...?

steps.name: Panicked Passerby
steps.text: Waaaagh—what's going on?! What are these things?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Where did this miscellany all come from...?!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: (Oh! What did I just step on?)

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Did this—fall out of my benefactor's bag?

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Pfhh?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Nothing!

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Ao—!!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Geh!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: What are you all charging at me for?!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: There's one more!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: That one was narrow! Much thanks, benefactor!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Ow—ow, ow...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But what could possibly be happening? Could there possibly even be more scoundrels working against us?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: I've got this feeling I've seen these things somewhere before...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Erk, you're right! They practically seem an homage to Miss Dusk's Ink Spirits!

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Fphhh...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Wargh! Were there still leftovers?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: They're all coming at the charm Nian gave to Lava. That settles it—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: —They have to be pretty much like Ink Spirits!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Liang Xun...!

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Lee.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The cup got stolen?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I was careless. It seemed to be a beastmaster's tame beast that did it...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Wasteland long-snouted slumberfoots have a special organ in them. There's some kind of hypnotic substance they can secrete.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But none of the sort live in Shangshu. Someone skilled, strong, and in command of beasts that put people to sleep? A fine accomplice if you're out to steal a cup.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: And the thief's not even with the inn people.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You ascertain that much?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You're not surprised at all. You figured it out long before I could, I'm guessing?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: The look on your face tells me this one was definitely unexpected.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Any immediate suspicions?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I didn't tell anyone at all where the cup was hidden.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I think you told someone else I had it on me.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I did indeed say that.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: That's good, then.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But look at this study. Completely neat and tidy, just missing that case you hid the cup in.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: So who can get into your study, and who could send someone to sticky-finger the cup on such short notice?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: —Don't—Don't tell me too much. I'm scared I'll get my feet caught in your bureaucratic vines.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Do you need my help to bring the one behind that thief to light?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Reclaiming the goblet should come first.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Moreover, hunting that one down... would be too hasty.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Hey, little girl.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: I have a name!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: You're so slow about everything... What did Mr. Liang say to you?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Some quite perplexing things, but absolutely not to do with your old dad this time.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Tch...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Seems our Miss Du Yaoye does like her father after all.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You said how you were all for young against old, and how you didn't even want to take this job, but you've got other ideas too, don't you?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: N-No talking about me for now! You know what's happening, so think how we can haul her back in, quick!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Easy enough.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: That Blacknight had real freak skills. You think it's so simple to get her?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: We're just in luck. The better the skills, the easier they take the bait.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But what's important is, as a Rim Billitonian, how she chased her way into Shangshu. And who it is controlling her behind the scenes.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: She's not from Lungmen?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I didn't hurry too fast from Lungmen to Shangshu. If she really was out tracking me down, she could've pulled things off at any Messenger station. Why wait to move until I'm on the Liang estate?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Not to mention, a Rim Billitonian wantonly raiding a Yan magistrate? Either she's an idiot, or someone's using her.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Hah. Doesn't that make her an idiot either way?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Not necessarily. People do act naive at times.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: When?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: When they want something from someone very badly.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Are you trying to tell me something?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You're imagining things.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Will Rhodes Island really do something just because you left that letter in your room?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: We have a level of trust.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Do you know them that well?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Good people always know each other well.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: His door's open... but where's Mr. Lee?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor, there's two letters here. It seems one's meant for us.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Let's see...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Benefactor, I admit I've been holding in my curiosity. Just what kind of person is this Brother Lee?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: ...Err.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: He's a detective. Had dealings with Rhodes Island since a while ago now... well, mainly the kids from his agency have.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: But little by little, him and us have gotten familiar.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I see, a detective... no wonder he's so meticulously minded. By his wardrobe, I would've guessed him to be some manner of tianshi with a mild hand for Originium Arts.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: What did Brother Lee write, then?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Says...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Read it for yourself.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: 'Cup was taken. Find Master Shen at ferry crossing,' and...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: W... Well, he really hasn't taken us for outsiders. Master Shen would be that boatman of some admittedly suspicious intrigue, no?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: If we don't get this sorted properly, Rhodes Island can kiss goodbye to not getting involved. Better we listen to Mr. Lee for now.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: He predicted this situation'd get more complex, so that's why he didn't want us involved at the beginning... Does this really mean he saw all this coming?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: How come you're out of things to say now? Really? We haven't run that far yet.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: And can you tell me how you know they're gonna listen to your letter at all?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If I start telling a youngster like you, Miss Du, it'll be your fault when you get bored.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: You love pretending you're so mature... That's why I hate all you kung fu nutjobs.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: You've got the wrong idea there. I run a licensed detective agency.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Does being the boss of one guarantee you're a detective?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What, you're wasting all this effort just to find this goblet's owner and nothing else? You swear?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Of course there's more. I want my own answers, too.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Y-You know, if what you say is true, couldn't that Blacknight bandit seriously just leave Shangshu?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: A thief with knowledge of how Magistrate Liang's study is laid out? She must be somewhere nearby, off to meet her puppet master.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: And on the off chance she scrams?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If a Rim Billitonian can get out safely after stealing the magistrate's property, then someone wants her leaving—or to put it the other way around, she's going absolutely nowhere.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Guaranteed?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Not that guaranteed, actually. It'll just be a gamble.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Then we're too late then, aren't we?!

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If worst comes to worst and she did scarper on us, then with your help, we'll just get her back.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Easy for you to say! How am I meant to know which way she went?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Well, if they've come prepared, then how do you find a single person in a Shangshu-sized haystack? Is one pair of eyes and one pair of legs going to do the trick for you, Miss Du?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Then what can... wait...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: It's not me who wants that lousy goblet, either.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Someone's stolen it? Brilliant. We'll go see just what fins those anglers are trying to fish up with it.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: Do you already have guesses for who they are...?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: All I'll do is ask is that you all take your seats.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Very rare you should call for me so early in the morning, my Lord.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Miss Ning...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: The camellias in the roadside garden have bloomed. Have you seen them?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You were the one who planted them.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Yes, much thanks to your tender care for them.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: You truly let your own garden run wild. 'Tis become a means for me to kill my time.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: I will sprinkle a few red plums next time, then.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: As you wish.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Why such agitation, my Lord?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: There's something I wish to consult you on, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Well, will you say it? Since when could you no longer say things straight, Liang Xun?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's to do with that friend of mine.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Do you not trust me?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I have always trusted you, Miss Ning.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Really? If so, why do you ask to confirm before you speak?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Er. You are completely right...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Though I do not mind the walk to see you, 'twould not be just to ask me some questions that you called for me, so rare that is?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: If I have displeased you, I humbly apologize.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Haha. Why the nervousness? Am I so frightening?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Yesterday morning, I went to old Zhao's jewelers', and had repairs on the bracelet you gave me. At noon, I went to Miss Wen's shop to pick furniture; I have long wanted a larger dining table...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: After, I went with Miss Wen to meet her husband at the dock.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: In the afternoon, we ate our meal at Chef Hu's, talked of everyday domestics...

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Finally, I went to Uncle Bai's, watched him teach his potter apprentices, and went on a stroll with him.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Is there anything you still wanted to ask, my Lord?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: The bracelet I gave you was just an ordinary silver one. It's not of great worth.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Really, may I not like it if it is not of great worth?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I hear Uncle Bai has had a cold the last few days. He's admittedly getting on in years; he's at the point he should be minding his health.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: He will.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: But Uncle Bai has been pottering in Shangshu for ten years now, every afternoon and for six hours. Thunder could not move him.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Habits become nature; there will be no exhorting him now.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: You met all five of them, throughout all of yesterday?

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: 'Tis routine matters.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I understand now.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: So, now you have finished questioning me, you shall next be heading out, my Lord, shall you not?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: It's almost daybreak.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: 'Tis early to be visiting the theater, no?

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Not a suitable time, indeed.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: And you know my body is frail...

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: I will go and brew some tea, then. You wait.

steps.name: Miss Ning
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Liang Xun
steps.text: Oh, yes. Miss Ning, the book you borrowed yesterday from my study... have you finished reading it?

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: It's day now.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: But the snow still hasn't melted.

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: I have something I need to ask you too.

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Do you see these... little whatsits multiplying?

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Phhh... ao!

steps.name: Miss Du
steps.text: What is this?

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Fphhh...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: If these things appear because of that goblet...

steps.name: Lee
steps.text: Then that means we bet on the right street.

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (...They haven't followed me? I'm finding this too easy.)

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: (Let's see this letter... that storyteller has seemingly changed profession? Pottery? Pottery what...)
Where are you going?

steps.name: Blacknight
steps.text: —Who is that?!

steps.name: Innkeeper Zheng
steps.text: Why is that 'unaccounted-for' goblet in your grasp?

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh...

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Ao?

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Wrrao!

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh... gkh...?

steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkh...

steps.name: Strange Object
steps.text: Ao...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: So you *are* here.
